verification_report.actual: BRCAm 1.5 mo (4.3 v 2.8); non-BRCAm 2.5 mo (5.3 v 2.8)
verification_report.verdict: PARTIALLY CORRECT - non-BRCAm gain of 2.5 mo falls outside the stated ~1-2 range

verification_report.actual: OS WAS reported for the BRCAm cohort: 20.1 v 20.9 mo, HR 0.88 (0.52-1.53), P=0.44 at 54% maturity. Non-BRCAm OS immature (21% died) and will not be further analysed.
verification_report.verdict: WRONG - should be 'OS reported, no difference', not 'not shown'
verification_report.source: GO_summaries/2023_Pujade-Lauraine_OReO.md (full-text extract; the PubMed abstract does not carry OS)

verification_report.actual: OS WAS reported and was flat: 26.7 v 27.1 mo, HR 0.99 (0.73-1.39), not significant (147/406 deaths)
verification_report.verdict: WRONG - should be 'OS reported, no difference', not 'not shown'

verification_report.claim: platinum rule: pfi >=12 -> ICON4 / CALYPSO / GOG-0213 populations, endpoint OS
verification_report.jay_from_memory: these three trials define the PFI>=12 OS tier
verification_report.actual: All three enrolled treatment-free interval >6 months, NOT >=12. ICON4's Italian protocol alone used >12 mo (75% of its cohort was >12 mo). Only ICON4 produced a positive OS result (HR 0.82, 0.69-0.97, P=0.02). CALYPSO was PFS-primary with OS explicitly immature. GOG-0213's primary OS analysis MISSED significance (HR 0.829, 0.683-1.005, P=0.056); only a post-hoc actual-PFI sensitivity analysis reached P=0.0447.
verification_report.verdict: WRONG on both the PFI cutoff and the endpoint attribution

verification_report.actual: No dedicated randomised taxane re-challenge trial exists, so the headline is right. But ICON4 supplies randomised prespecified-subgroup evidence: ~34% had prior paclitaxel+carboplatin, benefit was consistent with no significant interaction, and the paper explicitly concludes prior-paclitaxel patients should still be considered for re-treatment.
verification_report.verdict: PARTIALLY CORRECT - 'retrospective only' understates ICON4's randomised prior-taxane subgroup

verification_report.actual: Confirmed - no randomised re-challenge trial for any of the three in ovarian cancer. One multicentre RETROSPECTIVE PLD re-challenge series exists (PMID 30640698) if a non-trial tier is ever added.

Confirmed - no ovarian trial evidence. The single near-hit (PMID 36086790) is a case report on ICI re-challenge after immune-related neurological AEs: toxicity re-challenge, not efficacy, not ovarian-specific.

rules.pfi: >=6 (only trial-eligible band; see caveat - there is no PFI>=12-restricted trial)
rules.caveat: Enrolled treatment-free interval >6 months; >12 months only in the Italian protocol, though 75% of the cohort exceeded 12 months. Tests taxane+platinum v platinum alone - it establishes the re-challenge BACKBONE, not platinum re-challenge versus no platinum. This is the only one of the four platinum trials with a positive OS result.

rules.os: immature / not_reported (334 deaths at analysis; no OS HR published)
rules.caveat: Carboplatin+PLD v carboplatin+paclitaxel - BOTH arms are platinum re-challenge. Stratified by therapy-free interval 6-12 v >12 mo.

rules.os: negative at primary analysis (P=0.056). Post-hoc actual-PFI sensitivity analysis HR 0.823 (0.680-0.996), P=0.0447.
rules.caveat: Tests the ADDITION OF BEVACIZUMAB to a platinum-doublet re-challenge, not platinum re-challenge itself. A 7% stratification error was corrected only post hoc.

rules.os: no benefit (second interim 33.3 v 35.2 mo; HR 1.027, 0.792-1.331)
rules.caveat: Tests the ADDITION OF BEVACIZUMAB to gemcitabine-carboplatin re-challenge. PFS benefit stated as consistent across platinum-free-interval subgroups.

rules.verified_against: Eligibility criteria of PMIDs 12826431, 20498395, 28438473, 22529265 - all required >6 months
rules.caveat: Excluded from all four platinum re-challenge trials.

parpi_after_parpi.os: reported, NO difference in BRCAm cohort: 20.1 v 20.9 mo, HR 0.88 (0.52-1.53), P=0.44 at 54% maturity. Non-BRCAm immature (21% died), will not be further analysed. NOT 'not_shown'.

bevacizumab_beyond_progression.os: reported, NO difference: 26.7 v 27.1 mo, HR 0.99 (0.73-1.39), not significant (147/406 deaths, immature). NOT 'not_shown'.
bevacizumab_beyond_progression.note: Post-hoc BRCA interaction P=0.0004: BRCA wild-type HR 0.36 (0.25-0.50); BRCA-mutated HR 1.58 (0.667-3.71), i.e. no benefit. Worth surfacing in the ranker.

taxane.evidence: No dedicated re-challenge trial. Retrospective / single-institution series only, plus randomised prespecified-subgroup support from ICON4.
taxane.endpoint: PFS and OS (ICON4 subgroup; not a re-challenge-specific endpoint)
taxane.os: ICON4 overall OS HR 0.82 (0.69-0.97); benefit consistent in the ~34% with prior paclitaxel+carboplatin, no significant interaction.
taxane.verified_against: PMID 12826431 + GO_summaries/2003_Parmar_The Lancet.md; PubMed title searches (PMIDs 8780916, 19115681, 31011610) return only retrospective/case series for taxane retreatment

pld_gemcitabine_topotecan.verified_against: PubMed title searches 2026-10-05. Nearest items are retrospective: PLD re-challenge multicentre retrospective (PMID 30640698); gemcitabine PMIDs 34985551 (platinum re-challenge, not gemcitabine), 17429624 (case report); topotecan PMID 20383771 (PFI-extension feasibility).

immunotherapy_after_io.verified_against: PubMed title search for checkpoint-inhibitor rechallenge AND ovarian (2026-10-05): one hit, PMID 36086790, a case report on re-challenge after immune-related neurological AEs - toxicity re-challenge, not efficacy, not ovarian-specific.
